title: Nitrate reduction to ammonia using Cu–Fe nanoparticles
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00135H, Paper
Ido Dan, Paz Stein, Dyuti Bandyopadhyay, Yan Tetarevsky, Alevtina Neyman, Shir Abramovich, Rotem Geva, Maya Bar Sadan
